items.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: 我們正在關注賽諾菲收購Insmed、羅氏推銷乳癌藥物等新聞
items.summary: 法國藥廠賽諾菲（Sanofi）以410億美元大手筆收購生技公司Insmed，這項近年來最大的生醫併購案，將為賽諾

items.title: STAT+: Sanofi to buy Insmed for $41B, picking up two lung disease medicines
items.summary: Sanofi is buying U.S. biotech Insmed for $41 billion, a megadeal that will give the French pharma company two new approved medicines.

items.title: STAT+: Medicare estimates $9.2 billion in savings from third round of negotiated drug prices
items.summary: The Trump administration said that the federal government will save $9.2 billion on drugs purchased through Medicare next year as a result of price negotiations.

items.title: 美國食藥局（FDA） approves BridgeBio muscular dystrophy drug
items.summary: Wall Street analysts say a price of nearly $1 million a year should drive blockbuster sales for a medicine that helped patients walk and breathe better.

items.title: STAT+: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy gets its first 美國食藥局（FDA）-approved drug, from BridgeBio
items.summary: A type of muscular dystrophy that was long ignored has its first drug — and it could earn BridgeBio a billion dollars a year.

items.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about Capricor’s Duchenne drug, Lilly’s 15th acquisition of 2026, and more
items.summary: The 美國食藥局（FDA） again rejected a hotly debated experimental Duchenne muscular dystrophy drug from Capricor Therapeutics

items.title: Lilly buys Huntington’s drug developer LoQus23 in potentially $725M deal
items.summary: The acquisition hands Lilly what could become a first-of-its-kind treatment designed to inhibit a protein, “MSH3,” that can exacerbate the genetic abnormalities underlying diseases like Huntington's.

items.title: 美國食藥局（FDA） again turns back Capricor Duchenne 細胞治療
items.summary: In an unusual statement, the 美國食藥局（FDA） accused Capricor of “serious data integrity violations” that compromised its study findings and led to deramiocel’s second rejection since 2025.

items.title: Celldex 濕疹藥物踢到鐵板；表觀遺傳編輯新創公司裁員
items.summary: Celldex 的濕疹藥物遭遇挫折後，華爾街分析師紛紛出面力挺。同時，Isomorphic Labs 也與默克（Merck）和梯瓦（Teva）達成一項專注於癌症的合作協議。

items.title: 本週圖表觀察：生技投資人對中國的押注已開始見效
items.summary: 今年，以中國藥物為核心的公司正加速進行併購或首次公開募股（IPO）。與此同時，Summit 已不再是華爾街的寵兒。

items.title: TreeFrog Therapeutics 任命 James Sterling 為財務長
items.summary: 生技公司 TreeFrog Therapeutics 宣布，已任命 James Sterling 擔任公司財務長（CFO），負責掌管財務營運與策略規劃。
